scripts.typecheck: pnpm run console:typecheck && pnpm run desktop:typecheck
scripts.test: pnpm run dev:test && pnpm run console:test && pnpm run desktop:test
scripts.build: pnpm run console:build && pnpm run desktop:build
scripts.dev:test: node --test scripts/dev.test.mjs scripts/dev-port-check.test.mjs scripts/independent-dev.test.mjs scripts/backend-core-dev.test.mjs scripts/livekit-dev.test.mjs scripts/livekit-log-filter.test.mjs
scripts.check: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run knip && pnpm run test && pnpm run build
scripts.desktop:dev: node scripts/independent-dev.mjs desktop -- pnpm --filter companion-desktop run dev
scripts.desktop:test: node scripts/verify-live2d-assets.mjs && pnpm --filter companion-desktop run test
scripts.desktop:build: pnpm --filter companion-desktop run build && node scripts/verify-live2d-assets.mjs desktop/dist/renderer
scripts.installer:package:cuda: set NEARMATE_RUNTIME_PROFILE=cuda&& set NEARMATE_OUTPUT_DIR=cuda-unpacked&& pnpm --filter companion-desktop run package:unpacked
scripts.installer:package:universal: set NEARMATE_RUNTIME_PROFILE=universal&& set NEARMATE_OUTPUT_DIR=universal-unpacked&& pnpm --filter companion-desktop run package:unpacked
scripts.console:dev: node scripts/independent-dev.mjs console -- pnpm --filter virtual-companion-control-console run dev
